next:or:283.hint: 確実にそうなるよう気をつけることを表す命令表現
next:or:283.question: [[See it to that]] you arrive on time.
next:or:283.fullSentence: See to it that you arrive on time.
next:or:283.explanation: See to it that S+V『〜するように取り計らいなさい』。

next:or:284.hint: 彼が辞任するといううわさだ
next:or:284.fullSentence: Rumor has it that he will resign.
next:or:284.explanation: Rumor has it that ~『〜といううわさだ』。

next:or:285.hint: 前に出た可算名詞(不特定)を受ける代名詞
next:or:285.question: I want a new pen. A cheap [[it]] will do.
next:or:285.fullSentence: I want a new pen. A cheap one will do.
next:or:285.explanation: one=前に出た可算名詞(不特定のもの)を受ける代名詞。
next:or:285.relatedInfo: itは特定の同一物を指す点で異なる。

next:or:286.hint: この靴は好きではない。他のものを見せてください(複数)
next:or:286.fullSentence: I don't like these shoes. Show me some other ones.
next:or:286.explanation: ones=前に出た複数の可算名詞(不特定のもの)を受ける代名詞。

next:or:287.hint: 前に出た(単数・不可算の)名詞の反復を避ける代用語
next:or:287.question: The population of Tokyo is larger than [[one]] of Osaka.
next:or:287.fullSentence: The population of Tokyo is larger than that of Osaka.
next:or:287.explanation: that=前に出た(単数・不可算の)名詞の反復を避ける代用語(the population of Osakaの代わり)。
next:or:287.relatedInfo: 複数名詞の場合はthoseを使う。

next:or:288.hint: ここの物価は田舎の物価より高い(複数名詞の代用)
next:or:288.fullSentence: The prices here are higher than those in the countryside.
next:or:288.explanation: those=前に出た複数名詞の反復を避ける代用語。『人々』の意味でも使われる。
next:or:288.relatedInfo: 単数名詞の代用はthatを使う。

next:or:289.hint: 『そのような人・物』を指す代名詞
next:or:289.question: I never want to meet [[that]] a person again.
next:or:289.fullSentence: I never want to meet such a person again.
next:or:289.explanation: such『そのような人・物』を指す代名詞。
next:or:289.relatedInfo: such a personの形でよく使う。

next:or:290.hint: 鍵をなくしたが、後でそれ(その同じ鍵)を見つけた
next:or:290.fullSentence: I lost my key, but I found it later.
next:or:290.explanation: it=特定のもの・すでに述べたものそのものを指す代名詞。
next:or:290.relatedInfo: one(不特定の同種)との対比。

next:or:291.hint: 補語を強調するIt is ~ thatの構文
next:or:291.question: [[It is a doctor what he became]].
next:or:291.answer: It is a doctor that he became
next:or:291.fullSentence: It is a doctor that he became.
next:or:291.wrongPart: It is a doctor what he became
next:or:291.explanation: It is C that S became『Sがなったのは~だ』。補語を強調する強調構文。
next:or:291.relatedInfo: 強調構文は主語・目的語だけでなく補語も強調できる。

next:or:292.hint: 彼が謝って初めて彼女は彼を許した
next:or:292.fullSentence: It was not until he apologized that she forgave him.
next:or:292.explanation: It is not until S or O that SV『SやOして初めて〜した』。
next:or:292.relatedInfo: not untilを強調構文で表した形。

next:or:293.hint: 理由を強調する疑問文の強調構文
next:or:293.question: [[Why it was that]] she was angry?
next:or:293.fullSentence: Why was it that she was angry?
next:or:293.explanation: Why is/was it that ~?『〜なのはなぜですか』。疑問詞を強調する構文。
next:or:293.relatedInfo: Whyの強調構文バージョン。

next:or:294.hint: あなたが欲しいのは何ですか
next:or:294.fullSentence: What is it that you want?
next:or:294.explanation: What is it that ~?『〜なのは何ですか』。疑問詞Whatを強調する構文。
next:or:294.relatedInfo: 疑問詞の強調構文は日常会話でもよく使われる。

next:or:295.hint: 2者を対象にした全肯定の代名詞
next:or:295.question: [[All]] of the answers are correct.
next:or:295.fullSentence: Both of the answers are correct.

next:or:296.hint: 両方とも正しいというわけではない(部分否定)
next:or:296.fullSentence: Not both of the answers are correct; one of them is wrong.
next:or:296.explanation: not both『両方とも〜というわけではない』(部分否定)。

next:or:297.hint: 2者のうちどちらか片方を指す代名詞
next:or:297.question: [[Neither]] of the two roads will take you there.
next:or:297.fullSentence: Either of the two roads will take you there.
next:or:297.explanation: either『(2つのうち)どちらか一方』。

next:or:298.hint: (2つのうち)どちらも正しくない
next:or:298.fullSentence: Neither of the two answers is correct.
next:or:298.explanation: neither『(2つのうち)どちらも〜ない』。
next:or:298.relatedInfo: 3つ以上の場合はnone/not anyを使う。

next:or:299.hint: 3者以上を対象にした全肯定の代名詞
next:or:299.question: [[Both]] of the students passed the exam.
next:or:299.fullSentence: All of the students passed the exam.

next:or:300.hint: 全員が試験に合格したというわけではない(部分否定)
next:or:300.fullSentence: Not all of the students passed the exam; some failed.
next:or:300.explanation: not all『全部が〜というわけではない』(部分否定)。

next:or:301.hint: 3者以上のうちどれでも良いことを表す代名詞
next:or:301.question: You can choose [[either]] of these colors.
next:or:301.fullSentence: You can choose any of these colors.
next:or:301.explanation: any『(3つ以上のうち)どれでも』。

next:or:302.hint: (3人以上のうち)誰も答えを知らなかった
next:or:302.fullSentence: None of the students knew the answer.
next:or:302.explanation: none/not any『(3つ以上のうち)どれも〜ない』。

next:or:303.question: Let's think about [[another options]].
next:or:303.explanation: other『他の〜』(形容詞)。複数名詞の前に置く。
next:or:303.relatedInfo: anotherは単数名詞の前に置く。

next:or:304.hint: この車を売って別の車を買うつもりだ
next:or:304.fullSentence: I'm going to sell this car and get another one.
next:or:304.explanation: another『別のもう一つ』(不特定の単数)。
next:or:304.relatedInfo: another one=another car(繰り返しを避けている)。

next:or:305.hint: AとBは別物だ、を表す慣用構文
next:or:305.question: Loving is [[one thing, and marrying another]].
next:or:305.answer: one thing, and marrying is another
next:or:305.fullSentence: Loving is one thing, and marrying is another.
next:or:305.explanation: A is one thing, and B is another『AとBは別物だ』。
next:or:305.relatedInfo: 知ることと行うことは別、のような対比によく使う。

next:or:306.hint: 客は次から次へと入ってきた
next:or:306.fullSentence: Customers kept coming in one after another.
next:or:306.explanation: one after another『次から次へと、続々と』。
next:or:306.relatedInfo: one A after anotherは名詞を伴う形。

next:or:307.hint: 名詞を伴った『次々と別の〜』の表現
next:or:307.question: [[One after another problem]] arose.
next:or:307.explanation: one A after another『次々と別のAが』。
next:or:307.relatedInfo: one after another(名詞なし)との語順の違いに注意。
